verdict.rationale: Pulumi explicitly advertises migration from Terraform (pulumi-docs-10) and provides a generic `pulumi import`/`preview --import-file` workflow that adopts existing cloud resources into Pulumi state and generates code (pulumi-docs-6, -17, -21, -25), plus native HCL support (pulumi-docs-1/22) that can ease porting Terraform configs. However, this is resource-by-resource cloud-resource import rather than a direct Terraform state-file import, requires manual code review/copy-in, and no evidence shows automated bulk Terraform state ingestion, so it delivers migration with significant caveats.
